stage_definitions.run: a solver summary records successful execution (or W01 records completed solver evidence)

stage_definitions.reference_quality: an external anchor is present and its declared observable/resolution is accepted; partial anchors do not pass
stage_definitions.training_eval: case is in the W11 manifest for development T1/T2/T3/T4 and learned baseline coverage is counted separately
